bottlenecks.observation: Current UX/UI validators and publication packages require expanded schema 0.3 and whole-artifact review bindings.
bottlenecks.impact: Direct replacement would affect multiple validators, renderers, review and publication consumers before transport could be exercised.
bottlenecks.action: Evaluate compact authoring with deterministic projection into the existing validated consumer contract; preserve supplied IDs and meaning.
bottlenecks.result: Implementation selected for the first end-to-end proof; no live speedup yet measured

bottlenecks.observation: Exact import reduces compact Alexa UX bytes from 353586 to 339832 (3.9%); UI envelopes increase 89295 to 91646 (2.6%). Largest imported UX unit is 95628 bytes.
bottlenecks.impact: Transport alone does not prove large aggregate token savings. Preserved old data still contains expanded frames and detailed evidence.
bottlenecks.action: Keep file manifests small; read requested units and shared context once. New authors use linear steps and reusable visual parts instead of authoring graph/tree duplication.
bottlenecks.result: Example UX manifest is 540 bytes for two files totaling 43714 bytes; UI manifest is 513 bytes for two files totaling 7188 bytes. Live authoring savings unmeasured.

bottlenecks.observation: Whole-artifact review binds final UX bytes; appending UX changes its review subject.
bottlenecks.impact: Early per-batch composition cannot safely inherit the old whole-artifact pass.
bottlenecks.action: Retain foundation overlap; require final exact review before composition. Do not add ad hoc scoped approval receipts.
bottlenecks.result: Safe overlap documented. Per-batch reviewed composition remains a separate future change.

bottlenecks.observation: Saved UI assembly itself took 7.0 ms; validation took 283.5 ms and rendering 130.9 ms.
bottlenecks.impact: Existing consumer validation/resource work dominates this subsecond mechanical replay, not new indexed assembly.
bottlenecks.action: Cache identical complete assemblies and verify saved output bytes. Preserve all source units on repair; avoid broad validator rewrites for a small absolute cost.
bottlenecks.result: Identical UI replay took 89.3 ms. Changed whole-artifact bundles still require validation and rendering; external asset roots bypass cache reuse.

bottlenecks.observation: Initial new-flow test modeled a retry loop without a successful terminal outcome; the existing validator rejected it. The sandbox also denied a CLI child process.
bottlenecks.impact: Two initial focused tests failed, one useful semantic fixture defect and one test-environment restriction.
bottlenecks.action: Add the explicit successful outcome and run child-process tests with authorized escalation.
bottlenecks.result: All 18 focused integration tests passed; no validator weakening or fixture expectation suppression.

bottlenecks.observation: Standalone candidate previews originally referenced the publication stylesheet without copying it. Full formatting also found two unformatted imported reference documents.
bottlenecks.impact: HTML existed but standalone styling was incomplete; the repository formatting command failed.
bottlenecks.action: Include existing design-language CSS and bundled fonts; increment assembly producer identity to invalidate old cached previews. Apply formatting-only normalization to the two ref documents.
bottlenecks.result: Standalone preview resource test, final 14-test lane and repository formatting passed. No product design or reference decisions were changed.
